meta.name: flux-2-klein
meta.description: Generate images with Flux 2 Klein (Black Forest Labs' distilled fast variant of Flux 2) on RunComfy — bundled with the model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper output than naive prompting against the same model. Documents Flux 2 Klein's strengths (sub-second latency, multi-reference brand styling, declarative subject-first prompts), the step-count strategy (4–8 for fast iteration, ~25 for polish), the 9B vs 4B variant trade-off, and when to route to Flux 2 Pro / Seedream 5 / GPT Image 2 instead. Calls `runcomfy run blackforestlabs/flux-2-klein/9b/text-to-image` (or `/4b/`) through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "flux 2 klein", "flux-2-klein", "flux klein", "BFL flux 2", or any explicit ask to generate with this model.

copy.tagline: 用 Flux 2 Klein 模型快速生成图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用 Flux 2 Klein 模型快速生成高质量图片
copy.tagline_en: Generate images quickly with Flux 2 Klein model
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate high-quality images quickly using Flux 2 Klein model

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Flux 2 Klein 模型生成图片。它支持两种版本：4B 版适合快速构思，9B 版适合精细出图。你可以指定提示词、步数、尺寸，还能上传最多 4 张参考图来统一风格。
howto.when: 当你提到“flux 2 klein”、“flux klein”、“BFL flux 2”或明确要求用这个模型生成图片时，Claude 就会调用它。

say.text: 用 Flux 2 Klein 画一只蜂鸟，4 步快速出图。
say.note: 触发 4B 版快速构思，几秒内得到结果。

say.text: 用 9B 版生成一张陶瓷杯产品图，25 步，1024x1024。
say.note: 触发 9B 版精细出图，质量更高。

say.text: 参考这张图，保持构图和光线，把背景从海滩改成山景。
say.note: 上传参考图后，Claude 会按描述修改。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate images using the Flux 2 Klein model. It offers two variants: the 4B for fast concepting and the 9B for polished output. You can specify prompts, steps, dimensions, and up to 4 reference images for style consistency.
howto.when_en: Claude triggers this skill when you mention "flux 2 klein", "flux klein", "BFL flux 2", or explicitly ask to generate images with this model.

say_en.text: Use Flux 2 Klein to draw a hummingbird, 4 steps fast.
say_en.note: Triggers 4B variant for quick concepting, result in seconds.

say_en.text: Generate a ceramic mug product photo with 9B, 25 steps, 1024x1024.
